payload.text: hv cuts Utilz 2.14.9, 0132's fix, through devbin's core once 0132 lands (hv in vc's window, 2026-11-02, before the clock read 07:36Z by date -u): the first consumer cut in the new shape, ST0011 WP10 (utilz#ST0031). utilz-vc and utilz-dc bring vc and hv one plan first: tests.yml fires on candidate/** and not on tags (today it fires on main and tags, so pre-flight would refuse); tools/post-cut against the macOS leg the cut now runs at the release commit; a build: block wired to the cache. Its release check and dry run come to vc before hv cuts; every run books on this desk. After the cut vc reads its RELEASE seal for AC-3.4 (sign and notarise at the release commit as a leg), Utilz's part of AC-4.3, and AC-5.4 if a build: block is in. GO (hv in vc's window through the TUI, and in utilz-vc's at 08:22Z, Utilz vc decision 87; recorded 2026-11-02 08:23Z by date -u): utilz-vc's plan as sent. ST0031/04 by utilz-dc: U1 tests.yml (candidate/** trigger, tags dropped, macOS jobs on candidate refs) and U2 post-cut (app steps go; it keeps macos publish, since the cut attaches no app); then R1 post-cut 2.14.8 smoke, R2 release check, R3 dry run, each booked here; hv pushes main and vc reads CI; then hv's cut with a freeze. The build: block is not in this cut. After the cut, vc files the one core ask still wanted: the cut attaching macos.app in its object step, as bin-publish does for binaries (0.1.20's --pull covers the tap pull). RESUMED at hv's go of 2026-11-05 (decision 144), on devbin 0.1.20: utilz#0132 landed at efdd047d and closed at 58e45281, so the cut's precondition is met. The revised plan (Utilz decisions 89 and 90 at c54e89be, hv's go in utilz-vc's window) folds 0.1.20 in: hv's store-creds is done on rhadamanth, the only Mac that cuts Utilz (macos doctor: profile devbin PRESENT, one Developer ID identity, so no team:); release.formula stays undeclared and post-cut keeps the formula publish and the tap pull, since the object step attaches no Menuz.app.zip before a formula step would run (lib/cmd/release:2544, :3383-3402); 0313's pre-flight passes Menuz over, out of tree; U2 has no red arm at the base, a departure hv approved, since no suite names post-cut. R2 at the base read red as expected (utilz-dc's log r2-base-20261105T112042Z.log, sha256 a47682ca): the trigger, the one finding. vc checked U1 (its diff 5f343da2: push on main and candidate/**, tags dropped, the four macOS sites in devbin's candidate form, no tag test left in the file), and dc's step 2 landed at 195b1c91 (U1; U2's post-cut with critic-shell's five fixes; docs/releasing.md; the config's comments; CHANGELOG). Every desk run is read whole by vc and green: R2 at the fix (b8edfc3c, 'candidate/**' matches candidate/2.14.8); R3, the dry run of 2.14.9 (4fa38f9e, no step failed; CORRECTED 2026-11-12: a dry run starts no leg, the macOS stage included, in every release since 0.1.19 (lib/cmd/release:1680-1698), so R3 did not sign or notarise, and this line's earlier wording that it did was wrong); the tree-scan files under bash 3.2 (4ccb858e: common_lib 102, arngz 145 and macos 13 ok; no other suite reads a path step 2 changed); and R1, post-cut 2.14.8 (a2e693e8: the publish skipped, nothing published, no push). hv pushed Utilz's main (195b1c91 on local and upstream), and utilz-vc read CI run 42028263538 green on it: Ubuntu, Rust on Ubuntu, clippy and the shell analysis green, the macOS jobs skipped on a push to main as U1 intends, the counts as the last green main. hv's cut was granted at hv's go, held for another estate's image build at hv's word, then PAUSED at hv's word (decision 146): the utilz sessions localfold and hold through the bounce, and the cut never started (no candidate/2.14.9, no tag). After the bounce utilz-vc re-asks it fresh on hv's word; every run and the CI read at 195b1c91 carry over while nothing outside intent/ moves. AC-5.4 cannot come from this cut: no build: block, and Menuz builds out of tree.
